description:

title: AI & Biosecurity Research Resident
description:
Job Type:
Term (Fixed Term) Overview
RAND’s Center on AI, Security, and Technology (CAST), part of the Global and Emerging Risks (GER) Division conducts cutting-edge research on transformative, high-impact technologies-including artificial intelligence and biotechnology-to shape policies that protect global security and advance the public good.
Your work will address key questions related to global and emerging AI and biosecurity risks, understanding options for prevention and resilience, and examining their policy implications.
You will communicate the results of your work to both technical and non-technical audiences through quick-turnaround policy briefs and detailed written research products. A recent example of one of our research products is the Synthesis Screening report, which examined the current state of nucleic acid synthesis screening and offered recommendations for policymakers and industry leaders to further secure these technologies.
RAND's reputation for excellence is built on our commitment to high-quality, rigorous analysis and objectivity. In this role, you will apply quantitative and qualitative skills to rigorously analyze AI and biosecurity problems of national and international importance.
Qualifications
All research positions at RAND require excellent analytic skills; the ability to communicate clearly and effectively, both orally and in writing; the ability to work effectively as a member of a multi-disciplinary team; and a strong commitment to RAND's core values of quality and objectivity.
In addition, successful applicants will have:

• Experience in nucleic acid synthesis, AI-enabled biodesign, dual-use research of concern, potential pandemic pathogens, personal protective equipment, bioterrorism, or pathogen agnostic biosurveillance preferred.

• Demonstrated knowledge and ability to analyze or implement policies involving strategy, doctrine, operations, tactics, systems or organization.

• Ability for quantitative analysis and modeling, including modeling of uncertainty.

• Experience in government, intelligence community, or other relevant decision-making offices preferred, but not required.

• Ability to present evidence of research experience, demonstrated through authorship of academic publications, conference presentations, or prior professional reports.

Education & Experience Requirements
RAND is hiring multiple AI & Biosecurity Research Residents at the Associate, Specialist, and Expert levels of experience.
Minimum education and experience requirements at the Associate level include:
A PhD in Statistics, Biostatistics, Biology, Physics, Chemistry, Geology, or other natural and physical sciences is required - OR - PhD or equivalent in Policy Analysis or any technical discipline, Health Services Management, Public Health, Epidemiology or Business, with demonstrable proficiency in formal methods of decision support analysis is required.
OR
A Master’s degree in the fields listed above with at least 3 years of relevant professional experience, is required.
OR
A Bachelor’s degree in the fields listed above with at least 5 years of relevant professional experience, is required.
Security Clearance
Ability to obtain and maintain a U.S. government clearance is preferred but not required.
Location
We are hiring for this position in San Francisco, CA; Washington, DC; Santa Monica, CA; Pittsburgh, PA; and Boston, MA. We offer a hybrid work arrangement, combining work from home and on-site options. Fully remote work will also be considered.
Writing Sample
A writing sample of 3 pages or more is required for this position. Applicants are encouraged to use recent pieces that have been published in academic or other journals, but may use master’s theses or papers written for coursework, prior employment, or internships.
Term
This position is a 3-year term appointment with a possibility of renewal, alongside options for longer term employment.
Salary Range:
Biosecurity Resident, Associate = $126,400 - $183,

At CVS Health®, you’ll be surrounded by passionate colleagues who care deeply, innovate with purpose, hold ourselves accountable and prioritize safety and quality in everything we do. Join us and be part of something bigger - helping to simplify health care one person, one family and one community at a time.

The visit, which lasts about 45 minutes, allows for time to connect one-on-one and answer health questions. title: Platform Engineer
description:
ABOUT FLUIDSTACK

We exist to make humanity more free. For most of human history, you farmed or you starved. Technology gave people more time for the things they wanted to do, instead of things they had to do. Powerful AI will be the biggest lever for human choice we've ever built - but only if models are aligned with what humanity actually wants. There are groups building AI who don't share these goals. Whoever deploys frontier compute infrastructure fastest will decide whether AI expands human freedom or shrinks it.

We're singularly focused on delivering 10 to 100s of GWs of compute faster than anyone else, rethinking every layer of the stack. We acquire power, design and build data centers, and operate them - with teams spanning hardware and software. Speed and scale are our key differentiators. Come be a part of building civilization-scale infrastructure for AI.

We hire people who care deeply about this problem space. If that is you, please apply!

HOW WE OPERATE

- Be a barrel. Full autonomy. Own things end to end, take on scope without being asked, no permission required to operate outside your core role.

- Insane urgency. We drive everything forward as fast as possible.

- Reason from first principles. Challenge every assumption. Zero analogy thinking, no egos, the best idea wins.

- Love of the game. The frontier of AI is the most interesting problem of our time. We put in long hours at high intensity to push the frontier forward.

- Build something that actually matters. If you're going to spend your time, spend it on something that matters to the world.

THE SECURITY TEAM

Examples of key problems the team is working on

- You're securing the frontier of AI. The model weights training on our infrastructure are the most valuable and most targeted artifacts in technology, and we're standing up the compute to hold them faster than anyone ever has. A breach isn't a leak, it's the frontier walking out the door.

- Build the entire security program from scratch. Most leaders inherit someone else's system and spend a career patching it. Here you own it end to end, bare metal to boardroom, as we scale across continents.

- The industry's playbook was written for one building at a time. Vendor-managed appliances, manual process, and standards that assume a security team walks the floor. None of that survives contact with what we're building, so we build what should exist rather than buying what does.

- Your threat surface is measured in gigawatts. The customers running on our infrastructure are building the most consequential technology in human history, and being responsible for the physical and logical security of that work makes everything else feel small.

ROLE SCOPE

- Build the infrastructure as code that stands up a site's entire security platform, so bringing on a campus is a pipeline run rather than a project.

- Own CI/CD and the release path for the security stack, so every change reaches production tested, versioned, and reversible.

- Automate the remediation the team would otherwise do by hand, and hold the line that anything done twice becomes code.

- Build the package and patch pipeline that keeps a growing fleet current without a person touching a single host.

- Get the automation in place ahead of the platform it serves, so on-call stays something a small team can carry as campuses multiply.

WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

description:
Become a part of our caring community

Humana is committed to helping people achieve their best health by delivering innovative technology solutions that enable exceptional member and provider experiences.

The Associate Director, Segment Quality Engineering is a people and delivery leader responsible for executing quality engineering practices across a defined set of products, applications, or delivery teams within Humana ’s technology portfolio. Reporting to the AVP, Segment Quality Engineering, this role leads quality engineering teams focused on delivery quality, test automation, release readiness, and continuous improvement.

This leader will partner closely with Product, Engineering, Architecture, Platform, DevOps, and enterprise quality teams to embed quality throughout the software development lifecycle and improve release confidence, delivery speed, and production stability. The Associate Director will help operationalize segment quality strategy through consistent execution, strong team leadership, and measurable quality outcomes. Responsibilities

• Lead quality engineering execution for a defined set of applications, products, or agile teams within the segment portfolio.

• Manage, coach, and develop quality engineering leaders, engineers, and SDETs, with accountability for team performance, engagement, and growth.

• Implement quality engineering standards, practices, and governance established by segment and enterprise leadership.

• Drive quality planning and execution across functional, integration, end-to-end, regression, and release validation activities.

• Partner with Engineering, Product, and delivery leaders to ensure quality is embedded in planning, design, development, and release processes.

• Oversee defect management activities, including triage coordination, trend analysis, root cause follow-up, and corrective action tracking.

• Support release readiness assessments and ensure validation activities are completed for production deployments.

• Advance automation adoption across assigned teams, including sustainable regression coverage and improved testing efficiency.

• Help integrate automated validations and quality checks into CI/CD pipelines in partnership with engineering and platform teams.

• Coordinate non-functional quality support for assigned areas, including performance, resiliency, operational readiness, and security validation activities.

• Monitor quality metrics, delivery trends, and production outcomes to identify risks and continuous improvement opportunities.

• Escalate systemic quality concerns, portfolio risks, and capacity constraints to Director leadership as needed.

• Contribute to quality engineering modernization efforts through adoption of enterprise tools, reusable frameworks, and improved ways of working.

• Enable AI-assisted quality engineering within governed guardrails by piloting and scaling approved capabilities (e.g., test case generation assistance, risk-based prioritization insights, defect clustering/summarization, self-healing suggestions) to improve efficiency and signal quality.

• Promote responsible AI use on teams by ensuring AI outputs are validated, traceable where required, and aligned with security/privacy/compliance expectations; surface AI adoption learnings and needs to segment leadership.

Use your skills to make an impact

Required Qualifications

• Bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience.

• 8+ years of experience in software engineering, quality engineering, testing, or related technical disciplines.

• 3+ years of leadership experience managing quality engineering, test automation, or software delivery teams in enterprise environments.

• Experience leading quality engineering activities across multiple agile teams or complex applications.

• Demonstrated experience improving quality engineering practices, including automation, process improvement, and metrics-based execution.

• Strong understanding of Agile, DevOps, and CI/CD practice

title: Business Analyst / Project Manager
description:
Business Analyst / Project Manager
Overview
We are recruiting on behalf of our client for a Business Analyst / Project Manager. Our client is a UK-based consultancy that works with small business owners to map, measure, and improve how their businesses operate. This role sits at the centre of every client engagement - managing projects through a structured five-stage methodology whilst maintaining the day-to-day client relationship from first conversation through to ongoing support.
The successful candidate will split their time between project management and hands-on business analysis, running process-mapping workshops with business owners and ensuring that nothing falls through the cracks across multiple concurrent engagements. This is a fully remote position requiring alignment with UK business hours (GMT/BST).
Key Responsibilities

• Manage multiple client projects simultaneously, tracking the status of each engagement and identifying what is progressing, what is blocked, and what needs immediate attention

• Own the client relationship day to day - serve as the primary point of contact, communicate progress clearly and honestly, and set realistic expectations on timing and effort

• Build and maintain detailed project plans and Gantt charts, keeping them accurate as scope, priorities, and deadlines evolve

• Facilitate workshops and one-to-one sessions with business owners to map end-to-end business processes, producing activity diagrams and flow charts in Miro using standard UML notation

• Co-ordinate actions, dependencies, and outstanding information across clients, consultants, bookkeepers, and management accountants - chasing what is overdue before it causes delay

• Identify gaps, bottlenecks, and risks early, raising concerns proactively with the client and the internal team rather than waiting to be asked

• Maintain clear records of decisions, actions, and owners after every client interaction, and keep overall project status visible to the wider team at all times

Requirements

• Matric (Grade 12) as a minimum; a BCom, National Diploma in Business Administration, or a relevant NQF Level 6-7 qualification is strongly preferred

• Demonstrated experience in a business analysis role, including requirements elicitation, process documentation, and assumption testing

• Hands-on project management experience running several projects concurrently, with a track record of delivering on time and communicating clearly when timelines change

• Proficiency in Miro or a comparable online whiteboard tool, alongside everyday collaboration tools such as task trackers, shared documents, and spreadsheets

• Confident working directly with clients or external stakeholders, ideally owners or senior leaders of small to medium-sized businesses

• Comfortable reading and discussing basic financial information - P&L statements, cash flow, and business performance figures - without needing to be a qualified accountant

Preferred Experience

• Prior exposure to financial services, accountancy practice, consulting, or finance operations

• Familiarity with Xero or similar cloud-based accounting software

• Experience supporting SMEs in sectors such as construction, e-commerce, or professional services

• A recognised qualification in project management or business analysis, such as PRINCE2, PMP, or a BABOK-aligned certification

Key Competencies
* Strong communication skills
* High attention to detail
* Strong organisational skills
* Ability to work independently
* Professionalism and reliability

title: Sr. Software Engineer, Kernels/CUDA (C++)
description:
SpaceX was founded under the belief that a future where humanity is out exploring the stars is fundamentally more exciting than one where we are not. Today, SpaceX is actively developing the technologies to make this possible, with the ultimate goal of making life multiplanetary and expanding consciousness to the stars.

SpaceXSI is building Super Intelligence to help humanity understand the universe. Our teams are building the full Super Intelligence stack: from our Colossus supercomputers, to Grok models, to our suite of applications, including Grok Bot, Grok Build, Grok Imagine, Grok Voice, and X. We're creating a powerful flywheel where more compute trains better models, better models power more useful products, and what we learn from people using those products shapes what we build next.

SR. SOFTWARE ENGINEER, KERNELS/CUDA (C++)

We are building one of the world’s largest AI supercomputers from the ground up. As part of the Compute Infrastructure team, you will own both the raw GPU supercomputer and the platform layer that runs on top of it. You will work across the full stack - from low-level GPU kernel optimizations and Linux kernel internals to massive-scale orchestration and virtualization - to make training and inference at SpaceXSI as fast, reliable, and scalable as possible.
This is a broad, high-impact role that combines hardcore supercompute and compute infrastructure work. Your contributions will directly accelerate Grok’s training speed and overall AI progress.

RESPONSIBILITIES:

• Design, build, and optimize massive GPU clusters for extreme-scale training and inference workloads

• Develop and tune low-level CUDA kernels (GeMM, Attention, etc.), using CUTLASS, Tensor Cores, and Nsight for maximum performance

• Profile, debug, and eliminate bottlenecks across GPU memory hierarchy, networking fabric, filesystems, and multi-GPU operation

• Collaborate closely with AI research teams to deliver production-grade performance and scalability

BASIC QUALIFICATIONS:

• 5+ years of experience with low-level system programming in C/C++

PREFERRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE:

• Deep low-level systems programming (C/C++/PTX/SASS)

• Strong experience with large-scale GPU clusters or distributed compute infrastructure at production scale

• Hands-on work with GPU kernel optimization (CUTLASS, custom kernels, Nsight profiling)

• Track record of building or running high-performance infrastructure for AI workloads (training or inference platforms)

• Ability to reason from first principles and optimize for both memory-bound and compute-bound scenarios

COMPENSATION AND BENEFITS:

$200,000 - $375,000 USD

Base salary is just one part of our total rewards package at SpaceXSI, which also includes equity, comprehensive medical, vision, and dental coverage, access to a 401(k) retirement plan, short & long-term disability insurance, life insurance, and various other discounts and perks.
SpaceXSI is an equal opportunity employer. For details on data processing, view our  Recruitment Privacy Notice .

Що варто знати про SKELAR? Це венчур-білдер - іншими словами, компанія, яка будує компанії. З нами фаундери створюють consumer-бізнеси, які стають лідерами на глобальних ринках EdTech, Mental health, Petcare, FashionTech та інших.

 

Скеларівці будують tech-продукти, які здобувають відзнаки від Product Hunt, The Webby Awards та отримують тисячі позитивних відгуків на TrustPilot. Загалом tech-продуктами наших бізнесів користуються 10+ млн людей у світі.
Усе завдяки сильним командам, бо наші спеціалісти - це ключова цінність SKELAR.

 

Для професійної реалізації ми створили середовище з експертизою та необмеженими можливостями - і шукаємо тих, хто прагне викликів.

 

ЩО ТИ БУДЕШ РОБИТИ

- Data Pipelines: Будувати та масштабувати надійні ETL/ELT-процеси для збору та обробки даних про активність користувачів

- Архітектура та інфраструктура: Проєктувати хмарні сховища даних та аналітичні архітектури на базі сучасних data-інструментів (BigQuery, Airflow, Dataform)

- Data Quality: Забезпечувати високу доступність, точність та безпеку обробки даних; дотримання стандартів якості на рівні платформи - включно з data lineage та observability

- Крос-функціональна співпраця: Працювати разом із командами аналітики, бекенду та інфраструктури - перетворювати сирі дані на продуктові метрики та actionable insights

 

ЩО МИ ОЧІКУЄМО

Hard skills:

- Глибоке володіння Python та SQL: від побудови production-ready рішень до оптимізації запитів під реальне навантаження

- Практичний досвід із ETL/ELT-оркестрацією (Airflow, Dataform або аналоги)

- Досвід роботи з хмарними платформами (GCP, AWS або Azure)

- Розуміння data warehousing: dimensional modeling, партиціонування, кластеризація, cost control

- 3+ років як Data Engineer у продакшн-середовищах з реальним навантаженням

Підхід до роботи:

- Вмієш формулювати та відстоювати технічні рішення

- Готовий брати відповідальність за результат напрямку, а не тільки за свій код

- Проактивно підтягуєш колег - ділишся знаннями, робиш ревʼю, яке дає цінність

- Дієш як CEO у своїй ролі: бачиш картину цілком, не чекаєш задачі - формуєш порядок денний

Ми не прив'язані до стеку. Якщо ти вирішував схожі задачі іншими інструментами - розкажи як. Нам важливий твій підхід до проблем і здатність швидко розбиратись у технологіях та підходах.

БУДЕ ПЛЮСОМ

- Досвід на стороні аналітики (Data Analyst) - розумієш, що потрібно споживачам даних

- Досвід у ролі Python Engineer поза data-контекстом

 

У SKELAR ми побудували середовище для професійної самореалізації:

- SKELAR Platform. Це операційне ядро венчур-білдера, що допомагає фаундерам швидше проходити шлях від нуля до одиниці. Так команди бізнесів фокусуються на продукті - а 10+ команд в складі Platform закривають функції Legal, Finance, HR, Admin, Talent Acquisition, Employer Branding, IT та інші.

- Нетворк та обмін досвідом як частина культури. Серед наших колег - кофаундери, які запустили не один бізнес, а також найсильніші спеціалісти на ринку. Тож ми маємо доступ до необхідної експертизи на відстані витягнутої руки.

- Ексклюзивна доменна освіта. Ми створили власні навчальні програми для тіммейтів на вибір - від 2-місячної школи для менеджерів-початківців до інтенсивів про AI та професійних клубів з розробки, продакт-менеджменту тощо.

- Вплив на системну допомогу Україні. Маємо благодійний фонд SKELAR foundation, який створили самі скеларівці - і завдяки кожному співробітнику втілюємо важливі соціальні проєкти. Наприклад, заснували перший у Європі акселератор для ветеранів https://veteranventure.skelar.tech/ і формуємо майданчик для підтримки ветеранів на рівні держави.

- Екосистема для продуктивної роботи. Для скеларівців створені простори, які надихають на результат - з власним спортзалом, скеледромом, зеленими зонами Bali та бібліотеками. У спейсах, де сервіс, безпека та комфорт синхронізовані з темпом

description:

Founded in Hamburg in 2007, we have quickly grown into a global company with offices in major cities such as London, New York, Berlin and Tokyo. And we still have a lot of plans. Our constant growth does not only prove our success, but also keeps creating new development and career opportunities for our employees.

Are you ready to join us?

- Build and execute a territory plan that prioritises high-value target accounts.

- Generate your own pipeline through consistent, tailored outbound activity, while following up promptly on inbound interest.

- Lead structured discovery conversations to understand customer needs, qualify opportunities and identify where Statista can deliver value.

title: Staff Software Engineer
description:
Staff Software Engineer (EMEA)
Zenrows is the web data infrastructure for AI. Founded in 2021, we give developers, AI agents and businesses one reliable way to access, extract and structure data from any website, at any scale, however hard the site tries to block them.
Whether it’s an agent that needs fresh web context mid-task, an LLM application grounded in live data, or an enterprise pipeline pulling millions of pages a day, Zenrows handles the rendering, the anti-bot defences and the parsing behind a single API, 10B+ requests a month. Teams at more than 10,000 companies, including Microsoft, Amazon, Dell, IBM, Slack, eBay, EY, Nokia and Clay, rely on Zenrows to turn the web into a reliable source of data for their products, workflows and AI-driven applications, across e-commerce, finance, real estate and AI.
As we continue our expansion, we are now looking for a Staff Software Engineer to join us on a permanent basis and make an instant impact, working directly with the CEO and CTO.
The Role
AI runs on web data, and more and more of the work that needs it is done by AI agents. Zenrows is how they get it. Fetch gets any page past the toughest anti-bot systems. Extract turns it into clean, structured data. Batch and Crawl do it across whole websites.
We’re also changing how software gets built. Our engineers already write 100% of their code with agents. We are moving more and more operational workflows from manual, to automated, to autonomous, trusting agents with real work in production. Very few teams are doing this for real. We are, and we want you to help lead it.

What You’ll Do

• You’ll own a customer-facing product end to end: what it does, how it runs, and the business number it moves. There are no product managers here. You talk to customers, decide what to build, build it with your agents, ship it, and own it.

• The problems are real. Our systems run on thousands of CPU cores, handle millions of requests a day, and stay ahead of anti-bot systems built by companies many times our size. You’ll design systems that hold up under that load. You’ll also build the tests, evals and guardrails that tell us when an agent’s work can be trusted.

• As a Staff Engineer, you’ll shape how the whole company works with agents. When one team finds a better way of working, you’ll help turn it into the standard for everyone.

• Your days aren’t prescribed. You’ll look across the company, find where you can add the most value and go after it.

What We're Looking For

• You’ve built high-load, complex production systems and you’ve set the technical direction that other engineers followed.

• You put product first. You talk about customers and business impact before code, and you can say clearly what your work changed for the business.

• You’re all in on AI-native engineering. You build with agents every day, and you know how to verify, test and take ownership of what they produce. Bonus points if you’ve built and shipped products that use LLMs or agents in production.

• You write clearly. We’re remote and our agents work from written context, so a good spec or decision record is worth as much as good code.

• You’re comfortable working with non-technical people. You can sit down with sales, GTM or operations colleagues, understand their problems and turn them into something that ships, no translator needed.

• You take ownership without being asked. You’re comfortable with ambiguity, happy to experiment, fail and argue for ideas, and you think like a co-founder.

• You pick the tool that serves the customer. Today that’s mostly Go, AWS, and Terraform, and you are open to learn new languages and tools quickly.

• A love of hands-on work. You’ll still champion collaboration via knowledge-sharing sessions, kickoffs, and cross-team reviews, but this is an IC role at its heart, focused on building and influence.

• Availability to work EMEA hours, as our team collaborates across European time zones.

• Our p

title: Junior Creative Strategist
description:
The role at a glance
We're hiring a sharp, AI-native Junior Creative Strategist to make sure every video ad we launch is the best version of itself.

• Role: Junior Creative Strategist

• Salary: £40,000 - £45,000 base, depending on experience

• Location: Remote-first, based in the UK or Europe

• Hours: Full-time, flexible

• Reports to: a Senior Creative Strategist

About Elavate

Elavate is a UK multi-collagen brand for women 40+, built to help them feel like themselves again through menopause and beyond.
We launched in 2024 and have grown into one of the fastest-growing DTC brands in the UK. We're fully bootstrapped and have grown almost entirely through performance ads.
It started when our founder, Alex, got fed up of buying his mum overpriced, low-quality, bad-tasting collagen. So he made one that actually works, tastes great and is affordable.
Creative is the engine of the business. Our strategists, in-house video editors and agency partners put out 100+ new ad concepts a month across influencer, UGC, high-production, AI and animation formats.
The role
Our goal is simple: launch the best ads possible, as fast as possible.
Our strategists write the scripts and brief the concepts. Our video editors, in-house and agency, build the ads. You own everything in between: you take a raw script and make sure it becomes a finished, launch-ready video ad, on time and with zero mistakes.
That means reviewing every edit, giving editors notes that make the ad better, keeping the pipeline moving, and using AI to make the whole process faster every week.
The bar: when you sign off an ad, it should be ready to go straight live, with no second check needed. Our north star is a concept briefed this week and live in the ad account by the following Thursday.
What you'll actually do
Most of your week goes on reviewing edits and working with editors. The rest goes on the pipeline, learning from live ads, AI and scripts.
Review every ad before it goes live

• Watch every first draft from our in-house editors and agency partners, and leave timestamped notes in Frame.io.

• Catch everything: captions, typos, clipped words, audio levels, pacing, weak B-roll, hooks that don't stitch into the body, the product showing too early.

• Push past "correct" to "better": stronger hook visuals, music, SFX, text styles and cuts.

• Plan 3-6 cutdowns and extra hook variations for each ad, so we test more versions of every idea.

Make our editors better

• Turn scripts into clear briefs, with a short Loom showing the dream edit.

• Give specific feedback ("change X because Y") so the same note never comes up twice.

• Run weekly check-ins with your editors, match work to their strengths and keep output on track.

Keep the pipeline moving

• Own the production board in Notion: assign edits, chase deadlines and reassign when someone's off.

• Get influencer content over the line: every hook, every file and whitelisting access, tracked and ready.

• Hand final files to media buying, named and labelled so launches are clean.

Learn from what's live

• Read the comments on our live ads for objections, questions and new hook ideas.

• Know which ads are winning and why, and bring those patterns into the next edit.

title: Research and Development Engineer in Formal Methods - 12 months contract
description:
Who we are ?
Télécom Paris, part of the IMT (Institut Mines-Télécom) and a founding member of the Institut Polytechnique de Paris, is one of France's top 6 general engineering schools.
The mainspring of Télécom Paris is to train, imagine and undertake to design digital models, technologies and solutions for a society and economy that respect people and their environment.

Modern distributed systems are increasingly complex, with multiple interconnected components, services, and autonomous agents interacting in dynamic environments. Ensuring their cybersecurity requires analysing both potential attacks and the strategies that defenders can adopt in response. Attackers may exploit sequences of vulnerabilities to compromise a system, while defenders may react through countermeasures such as access restrictions, system reconfigurations, or Moving Target Defense mechanisms. Traditional cybersecurity analysis techniques often focus on identifying vulnerabilities and possible attack paths, with limited support for reasoning about the strategic interactions between attackers and defenders.
The VITAMIN-C (VerIficaTion of A MultI-ageNt system for Cybersecurity) project aims to address these challenges through formal verification. Building on VITAMIN, an existing modular model-checking platform for multi-agent systems, the project develops methods and tools for modelling and verifying cybersecurity properties in distributed and autonomous systems. Attackers and defenders are represented as agents with specific capabilities, objectives, and available actions. Their interactions are analysed using attack graphs, temporal and strategic logics, and model-checking techniques. This approach allows the verification of security properties, such as the preservation of confidentiality and integrity, as well as the synthesis of defensive strategies against known attack scenarios.
A central challenge of the project concerns the scalability of formal verification when applied to realistic cybersecurity scenarios. To address this issue, VITAMIN-C investigates symbolic and abstract model-checking techniques, together with a modular architecture supporting the integration of different verification engines.
Within this context, the R&D engineer will contribute to the design, implementation, and evaluation of formal verification techniques for VITAMIN-C. The work will focus on formal modelling of cybersecurity scenarios, strategic model checking, development and optimisation of verification algorithms, and their integration into the existing platform. The engineer will also participate in experimental evaluations using cybersecurity benchmarks and industrial use cases, contributing to the development of a practical verification tool.

Your main responsibilities will include :

• Carry out R&D work in formal methods and cybersecurity verification

• Contribute to the research profile of Télécom Paris and Institut Mines-Télécom

The candidate must have a sound knowledge of formal methods, transition systems, verification algorithms and software development. They must be able to design, test and document research software in a collaborative environment, and have a good command of English.
Skills in temporal or strategic logic, model checking, symbolic methods, SAT/SMT and multi-agent systems would be an advantage. Experience in cybersecurity, attack graphs, Python/C++ programming, Docker or distributed systems would also be an asset.
The candidate must demonstrate good team spirit, rigour, organisational skills, analytical and problem-solving abilities, as well as strong communication and technical writing skills.
Education and experience : Master’s degree (Bac+5) or equivalent; or a Bachelor’s degree (Bac+4) with at least 4 years’ experience; or a Bachelor’s degree (Bac+3) with 6 years’ experience; or a two-year higher education qualification (Bac+2) with 10 years’ professional experience.

title: Commercial Property Manager - Remote
description:
ROLE TITLE
Commercial Property Manager
We are looking for Virtual Professionals based in the Philippines.

• This is a fully remote Commercial Property Manager position.

• Applications with an introduction video attached will be prioritized.

• Due to the fully remote nature of this role, it is important that candidates are comfortable communicating on video calls.

ROLE SUMMARY
The Commercial Property Manager supports the day-to-day operations of a commercial property in Indianapolis, keeping leasing, tenant requests, maintenance, property information, and documentation moving without constant supervision.
You will manage multiple active workflows at once, including prospective tenant and application activity, lease paperwork, move-ins and move-outs, maintenance requests, vacancy updates, floor plan changes, tenant concerns, events, and property documents. The role requires consistent follow-through: identifying what needs to happen next, gathering missing information, coordinating with tenants, vendors, architects, and the property team, and tracking each item through completion.
This is an execution-heavy role for someone who can work independently, manage competing priorities, and make sound decisions about when to act, when to follow up, and when to escalate. You should not need a daily task list to stay productive or wait for someone else to tell you the next step.
If you are strongest in narrowly defined administrative tasks and require frequent direction to move work forward, this role is not a fit.
CORE RESPONSIBILITIES
Property Marketing and Vacancy Updates
• Keep commercial vacancies current on LoopNet MLS, including unit status, availability, renovations, and other relevant property information.
• Coordinate with the current architect when floor plans need to be updated because of changes to the property or individual units.
• Maintain accurate unit information across property marketing materials and internal records so vacancy information does not become outdated.
• Eventually take ownership of updating floor plans using AutoCAD or another floor plan editing tool.
Leasing Support
• Support the screening of new rental applications by gathering, organizing, and reviewing the required information before moving the application to the next step.
• Communicate with prospective tenants and applicants throughout the leasing process and respond to questions or missing information promptly.
• Assist with preparing lease documents and associated paperwork, ensuring required information is complete and organized.
• Coordinate lease signings and follow up on outstanding documentation rather than allowing paperwork to stall.
• Coordinate move-in and move-out processes and ensure the necessary information, documents, and follow-ups are completed.
• Support lease renewal activity by tracking upcoming renewals and coordinating the required next steps.
Maintenance and Work Order Management
• When a tenant reports a maintenance issue, gather enough information to understand what is happening, determine the appropriate next step, and avoid sending incomplete information to Jennifer or a vendor.
• Coordinate with internal team and vendors when repairs or maintenance are required.
• Track open maintenance requests through completion and follow up when a vendor response, update, or repair is delayed.
• Keep work order information current so the team can see what has been reported, who is handling it, what action is pending, and whether the issue has been resolved.
• Escalate issues when the available information is insufficient, the situation requires a decision outside your authority, or progress has stalled.
Document Control
• Develop and maintain standardized formats for forms and documents used across the organization.
• Apply consistent document layouts, fonts, formatting, and other readability standards rather than creating documents with inconsistent presentation.
• Keep documents organized and accessible so the correct version

description:
Founders’ Associate (m/w/d) - Management Track | PraxisEins, Düsseldorf

In vielen Regionen Deutschlands finden Hausärztinnen und Hausärzte keine Nachfolge mehr. Patientinnen und Patienten stehen dann ohne Versorgung da. Wir ändern das, und suchen jemanden, der dabei vom ersten Tag an echte unternehmerische Verantwortung übernimmt.

Über PraxisEins
PraxisEins baut Deutschlands führenden Primärversorger auf. Wir übernehmen Hausarztpraxen, digitalisieren sie mit eigener Software und verbessern kontinuierlich die Patientenversorgung, gerade dort, wo sie am dringendsten gebraucht wird. Seit unserer Gründung 2022 sind wir auf über 400 Mitarbeitende gewachsen. Unser Managementteam kommt u. a. von BCG, McKinsey, Goldman Sachs und Oaktree Capital und hat bereits erfolgreich Unternehmen auf- und ausgebaut.

Die Rolle
Als Founders’ Associate arbeitest Du direkt mit unseren Gründern/Partner zusammen und siehst das gesamte Unternehmen von innen: Strategie, Operations, Wachstum, Produkt. Das ist kein Analysten-Job. Du setzt um, was Du erarbeitest, und übernimmst Schritt für Schritt eigene Führungs- und P&L-Verantwortung.

Was Du bewegst

- Strategische Projekte: Von der Bewertung neuer Praxen über die Übernahme bis zur Integration in unser Netzwerk.

- Unternehmertum: Du analysierst KPIs, identifizierst Hebel und verbesserst gemeinsam mit unseren Ärztlichen Leitungen und medizinischen Teams Abläufe in den Praxen.

- Wachstum: Du erkennst organische und anorganische Wachstumschancen frühzeitig und treibst ihre Umsetzung voran.

- Produkt: Mit unserem Product & Engineering Team entwickelst Du unsere Software weiter und bringst die Perspektive aus dem Praxisalltag ein.

- Führung: Du übernimmst zunehmend Verantwortung für Teams und Standorte und schaffst ein Arbeitsumfeld, in dem Menschen gerne Leistung bringen.

Dein Management Track

1. Founders’ Associate: Du arbeitest an den wichtigsten Themen des Unternehmens und lernst unser Geschäft von Grund auf kennen.

2. Standortverantwortung: Du übernimmst die P&L für mehrere Standorte und stellst unsere Qualitätsstandards sicher.

3. Regionale Führung: Du gestaltest die Strategie Deiner Region und kannst Dich in kurzer Zeit in eine Prokuristen- oder Geschäftsführungsrolle entwickeln.

Das Tempo bestimmst Du durch Deine Leistung.

Was Du mitbringst

- Praktikum oder Berufserfahrung in einem anspruchsvollen Umfeld, z. B. Strategieberatung (McKinsey, BCG o. Ä.), Investment Banking, Private Equity oder ein schnell wachsendes Unternehmen

- Starke analytische Fähigkeiten: Du erstellst Geschäfts- und Finanzanalysen akribisch und kommunizierst sie überzeugend auf Führungsebene

- Unternehmerisches Denken und echtes Ownership: Du treibst Lösungen eigenständig voran, statt auf Vorgaben zu warten

- Lust darauf, Menschen zu führen, auch in medizinischen Teams

- Die Motivation, im Gesundheitswesen etwas Positives zu bewirken

- Ausgeprägte Fähigkeiten in Organisation und Prozessmanagement

- Verhandlungssicheres Deutsch und Englisch (mind. C1)

- Reisebereitschaft: mind. 1 Tage pro Woche in unserer Zentrale in Frankfurt, die übrige Zeit an unseren Standorten in der Fläche oder aus dem Homeoffice

Was wir Dir bieten

- Steile Lernkurve: Direkter Zugang zu den Gründern/Partner und einem erfahrenen Managementteam

- Klarer Aufstiegspfad: Als schnellst wachsende Gruppe in der Primärversorgung bauen wir heute die Führungskräfte von morgen auf

- Medizinische Grundausbildung: Auf Wunsch finanzieren wir Dir vollständig die berufsbegleitende Ausbildung zum Rettungssanitäter (ca. 4 Monate), damit Du medizinische Teams noch fundierter führen kannst

A GE Healthcare é líder global em tecnologia médica e inovadora de soluções digitais com mais de 100 anos de experiência no setor de saúde e cerca de 50.000 funcionários globalmente.
Permitimos que os médicos tomem decisões mais rápidas e informadas por meio de dispositivos inteligentes, análise de dados, aplicativos e serviços, com o suporte de nossa plataforma de inteligência Edison. •
Gestão de Vendas: Responsável pela venda de partes, peças e serviços para clientes que não possuem cobertura contratual, seguindo os processos estabelecidos.

•
Atingimento de Metas: Garantir o cumprimento das metas de fechamento de propostas e outras metas específicas da região de atuação.

•
Colaboração: Trabalhar em conjunto com outros membros da equipe para solucionar questões e alcançar objetivos comuns.

Qualificações Requeridas:

• Bacharelado concluído em administração ou cursos similares;

• Experiência prévia na parte comercial;

• Perfil com boa autonomia e organização;

• Ótima comunicação, proatividade e disciplinado referente as tarefas;

Qualificações Desejáveis:

• Inglês intermediário;

Nosso pacote de remuneração é projetado para desbloquear sua ambição, dando-lhe o impulso e a flexibilidade de que você precisa para transformar suas ideias em realidades que mudam o mundo. Nosso salário e benefícios são tudo o que você espera de uma organização com força e escala globais, e você estará cercado por oportunidades de carreira em uma cultura que promove cuidado, colaboração e suporte.

title: Part-Time Financial Admin Assistant (028 - 1479)
description:
​​Looking for Philippines-based candidates
Job Role: Financial Admin Assistant
Compensation range:$700 - $900 AUD/ Monthly
Engagement type: Independent Contractor Agreement
Work Schedule:Part-time, Monday to Friday, Available Sydney business hours (AEST/AEDT)
Who We Are: At Hunt St , we help Australian companies hire top remote talent in the Philippines. For this role, you will be formally engaged as an Independent Contractor (ICA). We are not an outsourcing agency. All of our roles are 100% remote, so you’ll be able to work from home.
Who The Client Is:
Our Client is an Australian care provider supporting clients funded through Aged Care, NDIS, DVA and private funding. The business is growing quickly, taking on new clients every week, and is building out its admin team to keep up.
Role Overview:
We are looking for a detail-focused Financial Admin Assistant to look after the billing data behind every client service. Your main job is to review completed shifts in ShiftCare one by one and enter each service accurately into the invoicing spreadsheet, which feeds into Xero. Accuracy is the most important part of this role, because every entry becomes an invoice. The role starts at about 20 hours a week, with strong potential to move to full-time within around 6 months as the business grows.
Key Responsibilities:
Shift Review & Billing Entry

• Review completed shifts in ShiftCare one by one.

• Enter each service into a detailed invoicing spreadsheet (27 columns) covering Aged Care, NDIS, DVA and private funding.

• Make sure every entry has the correct funding type and service details so it flows correctly into Xero.

• Check your own work, and flag anything missing, unclear or inconsistent before it is invoiced.

Staff Compliance Tracking

• Track staff police checks and screening clearances and keep records up to date.
Research & General Admin

• Complete research tasks and general admin as needed.

• Handle confidential client and staff information responsibly.

Requirements

Must-Haves:

• Experience in high-volume billing, invoicing or data entry.

• Strong Excel skills and comfort working in large, detailed spreadsheets.

• A very high level of accuracy and attention to detail.

• Ability to work independently and manage your own workload.

• Clear communication, including flagging questions or issues early.

• Responsible handling of confidential information.

• Availability for about 20 hours a week during Australian business hours.

title: Dealer Partner Support Specialist - Level 1 (United States)
description:
About AutoFi

AutoFi is the leading provider of digital commerce technology that powers the sales and finance experiences for the most innovative brands and dealers in automotive. The AutoFi platform enables a more transactional buying experience with $4B in funded loans processed through AutoFi annually. AutoFi ’s dynamic selling platform empowers dealers to sell vehicles more efficiently and profitably, both online and in the showroom. We are funded for years of future growth and backed by investors including Crosslink Capital, Santander Holdings USA, SVB Financial Group, Ford, BMW iVentures and JP Morgan Chase.
Our team is diverse - spread out across the U.S. and Canada, we have backgrounds from finance and technology as well as deep experience in all areas of the auto space. We’re empathetic, gritty, curious, and humble owners of this business and are supported by some of the biggest names in the auto and financial industries as commercial partners. We’ve never been more excited about the opportunity in front of us to help transition the auto industry from offline to online. If changing a trillion-dollar industry sounds exciting, we’d love to hear from you.
For more information, visit www.autofi.com.

About the Role
Reporting to the Manager, Partner Support Services, the Dealer Partner Support Specialist is responsible for supporting the ongoing operational health, configuration, and functionality of AutoFi 's products and services for our Dealership and Dealer Group partners. Acting as a key point of contact and subject matter expert following implementation, this role responds to partner inquiries, manages program adjustments, troubleshoots issues, and works collaboratively with internal teams and external vendors to ensure programs function as intended and continue to meet evolving business needs.

Partner Support Services plays a key role in operating as the first line of support for all of AutoFi ’s clientele. They triage and prioritize all incoming requests, resolve general inquiries, make program settings adjustments, work with vendors to align on integrated functionality, and ensure Clients/Partners are able to connect with the appropriate resources. They monitor expected program functionality, proactively taking steps to resolve potential gaps and capitalize on enhancement opportunities.

An ideal candidate will be a detail-oriented, resourceful problem solver who combines strong customer service skills with technical aptitude and a commitment to accuracy. They will be comfortable managing competing priorities, investigating issues independently, and communicating effectively with both technical and non-technical stakeholders in a fast paced environment. Success in this role requires accountability, sound judgement, adaptability and a proactive approach to maintaining program health and delivering an exceptional partner experience. This position includes occasional scheduled evening and weekend support coverage to accommodate Dealerships operating hours. Each member of our team is challenged to contribute in a variety of capacities across the entire organization and show their individual strengths, from product to customer experience.

Responsibilities

• Participate in and contribute to a collaborative, accountable team environment with a culture of open communication through knowledge sharing, constructive feedback, and a willingness to support shared priorities.

• Develop and maintain proficiency in AutoFi 's product suite, integration capabilities, and Dealer Partner use cases, providing informed recommendations to optimize program configurations and functionality.

• Serve as a primary point of contact for Dealer Partners, responding to inquiries, resolving issues, and managing requests professionally and efficiently in accordance with expected service levels.

• Maintain and optimize Dealer Partner program settings, configurations, features, and integrations, including working with JSON, XML, CSS, and Regex
